candidate_generation: Top lexical score (.4 TF-IDF + .15 BM25), positive scores only, stable tool IDs. Use full hybrid when fewer than 10 eligible tools share terms.
bucket_order: Sort document texts by character count before batches of up to 32. Preserve the original order for lexical and dense scoring.
measurement: Three independent cold processes, same first query across strategies per seed. Then one shuffled pass; p95 includes remaining lazy index work. No disk embedding cache.
